title: The Need for Speed: Special Edition 64bit

note.default: Nothing is compiled: the setup downloads this project's newest Windows release from GitHub (about 3 MB) and points it at your copy. It takes under a minute and needs your full copy of the English Windows 95 Special Edition, the CD or a folder with everything from it (the one that holds NFS_WIN.EXE). Windows only.
